name: Pregnenolone
lead: Pregnenolone is a steroid made from cholesterol that serves as the biosynthetic precursor of other steroid hormones, including progesterone, cortisol, DHEA, testosterone and estrogens [2][4]. It is produced in the adrenal glands, gonads and brain, and is also classed as a neurosteroid [5][23]. It is sold as an over-the-counter dietary supplement in the United States.

In looksmaxxing and testosterone-optimisation circles it is discussed as a hormone-support supplement, often alongside DHEA, and in the concept of "pregnenolone steal", the idea that stress and stimulants divert pregnenolone away from sex-hormone production toward cortisol [26]. Users report supplementing for mood, libido, anxiety and brain fog [33][32].

Controlled trials of oral pregnenolone have been conducted mainly in psychiatry, such as bipolar depression and schizophrenia [6][14]. No trial found here has tested it for testosterone levels, physique or appearance outcomes.

Sold as a dietary supplement in the US; availability varies elsewhere

paras: Pregnenolone is formed when the enzyme CYP11A1 cleaves the side chain of cholesterol inside mitochondria, a rate-limiting step regulated by the steroidogenic acute regulatory protein [11][2]. From pregnenolone, downstream enzymes lead to progesterone, mineralocorticoids, glucocorticoids and sex steroids [2][4]. Leydig cells in the testis perform this conversion for testosterone production [3]. Pregnenolone is also made in the brain, where research in animals has linked it to neurosteroid activity and, in one mouse study, recognition memory [5][8]. In rat hippocampal tissue, neurons were found to make estradiol from pregnenolone [12]. Pregnenolone and related pregnanes also activate the pregnane X receptor, a nuclear receptor that induces drug-metabolising enzymes [9][10].

On looksmax.org, an original post describes pregnenolone as the base of the steroid pathway and recommends supplementing it for broad benefits [23]. Another thread argues that caffeine and stimulants lower testosterone through "pregnenolone steal" [24], and a third relays advice from the Ray Peat-influenced community to combine pregnenolone with other drugs for stress and attention problems [25]. On T Nation, users on TRT report adding pregnenolone with DHEA, or take it for anxiety, mood, libido and water retention [30][32][33][35]. Other posters dispute its value, saying that people who eat adequate cholesterol should not need it [27], and one user reports no noticeable effect from cream or pills [31].

A randomized placebo-controlled trial in 80 adults with bipolar depression tested add-on pregnenolone for 12 weeks [6]. Further trials and registrations have examined it in schizophrenia [14][17], autism [15][19], depression with substance use [20], alcohol or cannabis use disorders [13][16], PTSD [18] and perceived social isolation [21]. The studies are psychiatric and clinical, and none concerns healthy men seeking testosterone or physique effects. A 1950 clinical article is among the earliest in the medical literature [7].

A US-listed homeopathic oral product that includes pregnenolone alongside DHEA, estradiol, progesterone and testosterone carries the statement that its claims are based on traditional homeopathic practice and that it is not FDA evaluated [22]. Hormone precursors in the body are converted to downstream steroids in ways that vary between individuals, and a clinician-supervised approach is advised in one forum post [29]; published trials in healthy users are lacking.

timeline.event: Pregnenolone appears in the clinical endocrine literature [7].

lore.intro: Pregnenolone is described on looksmax.org and T Nation as a master precursor hormone to supplement or protect from being "stolen" by stress [23][24][26].

claims.claim: Pregnenolone is the mother hormone, so supplementing raises testosterone
claims.believers: Proponents point to its place at the base of the steroid pathway and recommend it for hormone support [23][34].
claims.experts: Pregnenolone is the biochemical precursor of other steroids [2], but no trial found here shows that oral supplementation raises testosterone in healthy men.

claims.claim: "Pregnenolone steal": caffeine and stress divert it from testosterone to cortisol
claims.believers: Posts argue that stimulants and stress consume pregnenolone for cortisol, reducing the supply for DHEA, testosterone and estrogen [24][26].
claims.experts: Steroidogenesis reviews describe shared upstream steps for cortisol and sex steroids [2][4]; the cited literature does not demonstrate that dietary stimulants deplete testosterone through this route.

claims.claim: Pregnenolone improves mood, anxiety and brain fog
claims.believers: Users report improved verbal fluency, libido and energy, and relief from anxiety on TRT [33][32].
claims.experts: A randomized trial in bipolar depression tested add-on pregnenolone [6], and other psychiatric trials are registered [14][15]; results in healthy people seeking cognitive effects have not been shown here.

claims.claim: Pregnenolone is needed on TRT to restore a full hormone profile
claims.believers: Posters suggest checking and supplementing it with DHEA alongside testosterone therapy [28][29][35].
claims.experts: No cited trial has examined pregnenolone supplementation alongside testosterone replacement. A counter-view on the forum is that adequate dietary cholesterol removes the need [27].

card.summary: The body's master steroid precursor, sold as a supplement for hormone support; trials exist for psychiatric uses, none for testosterone or looks.
card.note: Downstream conversion varies by person; no trials in healthy men for hormone or appearance outcomes.

quick.overview:
Pregnenolone is made from cholesterol and sits at the start of the steroid pathway, leading to progesterone, cortisol, DHEA, testosterone and estrogens. It is also made in the brain.

On forums it is taken for hormone support, mood and libido, and discussed through the 'pregnenolone steal' idea. Controlled trials have been psychiatric, not about testosterone or appearance.
quick.mechanism: The body converts it enzymatically into other steroids, and it acts as a neurosteroid in the brain. Whether swallowed pregnenolone becomes testosterone in a useful way in healthy men has not been shown in the cited trials.
quick.risks: Because it feeds several hormone pathways, effects can be unpredictable, and a forum poster advises supervision. It is sold as a US supplement with limited regulatory evaluation; long-term data in healthy users are lacking.
